Name: nonparelli's Hat Mouse Lacey Portraits
Author: opticalshort
Description:
This is a content patcher mod, so you just need to add it to your mods folder! No need to manually replace any portraits.
You can choose between the two variants via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by changing "WhiteAccents" to either "true" or "false" in the config.json.

Downloads.Description: Added the new expression, and tweaked old sad expression(s)
